observations.text: Across three Diabetes Panel reports, HbA1c went from 8.4% (2026-04-12) to 7.6% (2026-07-11) to 6.9% (2026-10-19), and fasting plasma glucose went from 171 to 152 to 128 mg/dL. The reports flag these values as above reference ranges.
